Build version stamp, bottom-right (2026-10-23)

  • Every page in the main layout now shows the build version as vYYMMDD (here v261023) in the bottom-right corner.
  • It is stamped at build time from the build date (AssemblyMetadata BuildVersion in the client csproj), so a CI deploy shows the day it was built. No manual step.
  • It is small, uses the theme's muted text color, and is click-through, so it never blocks a control. It sits under dialogs and the mobile drawer scrim.
  • It is rendered by App.razor, so the sign-in page shows it too.
